  rw [show ((1 + X ^ (2 ^ k) : ℚ[X])).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) = (1 + X ^ (2 ^ k) : ℂ[X]) by
      simp [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_one, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X],
    show ((numB n).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) =
        (numB n).map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) by
      rw [Polynomial.map_map]
      rfl] at hpq_C
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hpq_C
  apply numB_map_eval_at_zetaRoot_ne_zero n k hk
  rw [hr, Polynomial.eval_mul, one_add_X_pow_two_pow_eval_zetaRoot k, zero_mul]

name: coprime_with_base_factor
statement:
lemma coprime_with_base_factor (n k : ℕ) (hk : n / 2 ^ k > 0) :
    IsCoprime ((numB n).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))
      ((1 + X ^ (2 ^ k) : ℚ[X]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCoprime_comm, (one_add_X_pow_two_pow_irreducible_rat k).coprime_iff_not_dvd]
  exact not_one_add_X_pow_two_pow_dvd_numB_rat n k hk

name: conj5
statement:
theorem conj5 (n : ℕ) (_hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    IsCoprime
      ((numB n).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))
      ((denB n).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [denB_map_eq]
  refine IsCoprime.prod_right fun k _ => ?_
  by_cases hq : n / 2 ^ k = 0
  · rw [hq, pow_zero]
    exact isCoprime_one_right
  · exact (coprime_with_base_factor n k (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hq)).pow_right

name: n_le_A
statement: lemma n_le_A (n : ℕ) : n ≤ A n
proof:
:= by
  have h : n / 3 ^ 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n / 3 ^ k :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => n / 3 ^ k) (s := Finset.range (n + 1))
      (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n))
  simpa [A] using h

name: partition_card_le
statement: lemma partition_card_le (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n) : lam.parts.card ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := lam.parts_sum
  have h := Multiset.card_nsmul_le_sum (fun p hp => lam.parts_pos hp)
  simp at h
  omega

name: count_mul_le_sum_aux
statement:
lemma count_mul_le_sum_aux (s : Multiset ℕ) (a : ℕ) :
    s.count a * a ≤ s.sum
proof:
:= by
  have h_filter_eq_replicate : s.filter (· = a) = Multiset.replicate (s.count a) a :=
    Multiset.filter_eq' s a
  have h_sum_filter : (s.filter (· = a)).sum = s.count a * a := by
    rw [h_filter_eq_replicate, Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have h_sum_le : (s.filter (· = a)).sum ≤ s.sum := by
    have := Multiset.filter_add_not (· = a) s
    have := Multiset.sum_add (s.filter (· = a)) (s.filter (fun x => ¬ x = a))
    grind
  omega

name: count_three_pow_le_div
statement:
lemma count_three_pow_le_div (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n) (k : ℕ) :
    lam.parts.count (3 ^ k) ≤ n / 3 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (pow_pos (by norm_num) k)]
  calc Multiset.count (3 ^ k) lam.parts * 3 ^ k
      ≤ lam.parts.sum := count_mul_le_sum_aux lam.parts (3 ^ k)
    _ = n := lam.parts_sum

name: ternary_part_exp_le
statement:
lemma ternary_part_exp_le (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n)
    (hlam : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ lam.parts) :
    ∃ k, k ≤ n ∧ i = 3 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hlam
  obtain ⟨k, hik⟩ := hlam i hi
  refine ⟨k, ?_, hik⟩
  have hcount : 1 ≤ lam.parts.count i := Multiset.one_le_count_iff_mem.mpr hi
  have hi_le : i ≤ n := by
    calc i = 1 * i := (one_mul i).symm
      _ ≤ lam.parts.count i * i := Nat.mul_le_mul_right i hcount
      _ ≤ lam.parts.sum := count_mul_le_sum_aux lam.parts i
      _ = n := lam.parts_sum
  rw [hik] at hi_le
  by_contra hk
  push_neg at hk
  have h1 : 3 ^ (n + 1) ≤ 3 ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hk
  have h2 : n < 3 ^ n := Nat.lt_pow_self (by norm_num : 1 < 3)
  omega

name: sum_count_three_pow_eq_card
statement:
lemma sum_count_three_pow_eq_card (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n)
    (hlam : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), lam.parts.count (3 ^ k) = lam.parts.card
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun k : ℕ => (3 : ℕ) ^ k) (Finset.range (n + 1)) := by
    intro x _ y _ hxy
    exact Nat.pow_right_injective (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3) hxy
  have hsum :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), lam.parts.count (3 ^ k)) =
        ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).image (fun k : ℕ => (3 : ℕ) ^ k),
          lam.parts.count a := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
  rw [hsum]
  rw [← Multiset.toFinset_sum_count_eq]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_subset ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hx
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hxk⟩ := ternary_part_exp_le n lam hlam x hx
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, ?_, hxk.symm⟩
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  · intros x _ hx
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hx
    exact Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr hx

name: sum_diff_eq_A_sub_card
statement:
lemma sum_diff_eq_A_sub_card (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n)
    (hlam : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n / 3 ^ k - lam.parts.count (3 ^ k))
      = A n - lam.parts.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [A, ← sum_count_three_pow_eq_card n lam hlam]
  exact Finset.sum_tsub_distrib _ (fun k _ => count_three_pow_le_div n lam k)

name: hPoly_eval_one
statement:
lemma hPoly_eval_one (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n) (hlam : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n) :
    (hPoly n lam).eval 1 = (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - lam.parts.card)
proof:
:= by
  have heach : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      ((1 + (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k))
        ^ (n / 3 ^ k - lam.parts.count (3 ^ k))).eval 1
      = (2 : ℤ) ^ (n / 3 ^ k - lam.parts.count (3 ^ k)) := fun k _ => by
    simp [Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_one, Polynomial.eval_X]
  rw [hPoly, eval_prod, Finset.prod_congr rfl heach,
    Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, sum_diff_eq_A_sub_card n lam hlam]

name: hPoly_monic
statement: lemma hPoly_monic (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n) : (hPoly n lam).Monic
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun k _ => ?_)
  refine Monic.pow ?_ _
  rw [show (1 : Polynomial ℤ) + (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k) =
        (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k) + 1 by ring]
  exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add_C 1 (by positivity)

name: exists_allOnes
statement:
lemma exists_allOnes (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ lam : Nat.Partition n, lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n ∧ lam.parts.card = n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨Multiset.replicate n 1, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, Multiset.card_replicate n 1⟩
  · intro i hi
    rw [Multiset.eq_of_mem_replicate hi]
    exact Nat.one_pos
  · rw [Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  · simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    intro i hi
    rw [Multiset.eq_of_mem_replicate hi]
    exact ⟨0, by norm_num⟩

name: ternaryPartitions_nonempty
statement: lemma ternaryPartitions_nonempty (n : ℕ) : (ternaryPartitions n).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, (exists_allOnes n).choose_spec.1⟩

name: G_T_monic
statement: lemma G_T_monic (n : ℕ) : (G_T n).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold G_T
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := ternaryPartitions_nonempty n
  have hfi := hPoly_monic n lam
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : (ternaryPartitions n).gcd (hPoly n) ∣ hPoly n lam := Finset.gcd_dvd hlam
  set p := (ternaryPartitions n).gcd (hPoly n)
  have hlead : (hPoly n lam).leadingCoeff = p.leadingCoeff * r.leadingCoeff := by
    rw [hr, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul]
  rw [show (hPoly n lam).leadingCoeff = 1 from hfi] at hlead
  rcases Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one hlead.symm with hpos | hneg
  · exact hpos
  exfalso
  have hnorm : normalize p = p := Finset.normalize_gcd
  grind [leadingCoeff_normalize, Int.nonneg_iff_normalize_eq_self]

name: X_add_one_dvd_one_add_X_pow_three_pow
statement:
lemma X_add_one_dvd_one_add_X_pow_three_pow (k : ℕ) :
    ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) + 1) ∣ (1 + (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  have hmod : (3 : ℕ) ^ k % 2 = 1 := by rw [Nat.pow_mod]; simp
  have hneg : (-1 : ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k) = -1 := Odd.neg_one_pow ⟨3 ^ k / 2, by omega⟩
  have heval : Polynomial.eval (-1 : ℤ) (1 + (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k)) = 0 := by
    simp [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_one, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X, hneg]
  have hroot : ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) - Polynomial.C (-1 : ℤ)) ∣
      (1 + (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k)) := by
    refine Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr ?_
    simpa [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X] using heval
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hroot

name: X_add_one_pow_dvd_hPoly_card
statement:
lemma X_add_one_pow_dvd_hPoly_card (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n)
    (hlam : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n) :
    ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) + 1) ^ (A n - lam.parts.card) ∣ hPoly n lam
proof:
:= by
  have hfac : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) + 1) ^ (n / 3 ^ k - lam.parts.count (3 ^ k))
        ∣ (1 + (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k))
            ^ (n / 3 ^ k - lam.parts.count (3 ^ k)) :=
    fun k _ => pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd (X_add_one_dvd_one_add_X_pow_three_pow k) _
  have hprod := Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd _ _ hfac
  rwa [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, sum_diff_eq_A_sub_card n lam hlam] at hprod

name: X_add_one_pow_dvd_hPoly
statement:
lemma X_add_one_pow_dvd_hPoly (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n)
    (hlam : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n) :
    ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) + 1) ^ (A n - n) ∣ hPoly n lam
proof:
:=
  dvd_trans (pow_dvd_pow _ (Nat.sub_le_sub_left (partition_card_le n lam) (A n)))
    (X_add_one_pow_dvd_hPoly_card n lam hlam)

name: X_add_one_pow_dvd_G_T
statement:
lemma X_add_one_pow_dvd_G_T (n : ℕ) :
    ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) + 1) ^ (A n - n) ∣ G_T n
proof:
:=
  Finset.dvd_gcd (fun lam hlam => X_add_one_pow_dvd_hPoly n lam hlam)

name: hPoly_map_eval_eq
statement:
lemma hPoly_map_eval_eq (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n) (x : ℝ) :
    ((hPoly n lam).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)).eval x =
      ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (1 + x ^ (3 ^ k)) ^ (n / 3 ^ k - lam.parts.count (3 ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  simp [hPoly, Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_add,
    Polynomial.eval_one, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.map_prod, Polynomial.map_pow,
    Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_one, Polynomial.map_X]

name: hPoly_eval_pos_real
statement:
lemma hPoly_eval_pos_real (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 < ((hPoly n lam).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)).eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [hPoly_map_eval_eq n lam x]
  refine Finset.prod_pos (fun k _ => pow_pos ?_ _)
  have := pow_pos hx (3 ^ k)
  linarith

name: monic_no_pos_root_pos_at_one
statement:
lemma monic_no_pos_root_pos_at_one {P : Polynomial ℝ} (hP : P.Monic)
    (h : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → P.eval x ≠ 0) : 0 < P.eval 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : P.natDegree = 0
  · rw [hP.natDegree_eq_zero.mp hd]
    simp
  have hdeg : 0 < P.degree :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd)
  have hlc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ P.leadingCoeff := hP ▸ zero_le_one
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp
    (Polynomial.tendsto_atTop_of_leadingCoeff_nonneg P hdeg hlc) 1
  set M : ℝ := max i 1
  have hM_ge_one : 1 ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hPM_pos : 0 < P.eval M := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hi _ (le_max_left _ _))
  by_contra hneg
  push_neg at hneg
  obtain ⟨r, hr_mem, hPr⟩ :=
    intermediate_value_Icc hM_ge_one P.continuous.continuousOn ⟨hneg, hPM_pos.le⟩
  exact h r (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr_mem.1) hPr

name: G_T_eval_one_pos
statement: lemma G_T_eval_one_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < (G_T n).eval 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ := ternaryPartitions_nonempty n
  set P : Polynomial ℝ := (G_T n).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) with hPdef
  have hPm : P.Monic := (G_T_monic n).map _
  have hdvd_real : P ∣ ((hPoly n lam).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) :=
    Polynomial.map_dvd (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (Finset.gcd_dvd hlam)
  have hnoroot : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → P.eval x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx hxroot
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hdvd_real
    exact (hPoly_eval_pos_real n lam x hx).ne' (by rw [hQ, Polynomial.eval_mul, hxroot, zero_mul])
  have hP1 := monic_no_pos_root_pos_at_one hPm hnoroot
  have heq : P.eval 1 = (((G_T n).eval 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by rw [hPdef]; simp
  rw [heq] at hP1
  exact_mod_cast hP1

name: G_T_eval_one
statement: lemma G_T_eval_one (n : ℕ) : (G_T n).eval 1 = (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨lam₁, hlam₁_mem, hlam₁_card⟩ := exists_allOnes n
  have h_eval_dvd : (G_T n).eval 1 ∣ (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - n) := by
    have h := Polynomial.eval_dvd (Finset.gcd_dvd hlam₁_mem (f := hPoly n)) (x := (1 : ℤ))
    rwa [hPoly_eval_one n lam₁ hlam₁_mem, hlam₁_card] at h
  have h_two_pow_dvd : (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - n) ∣ (G_T n).eval 1 := by
    simpa using Polynomial.eval_dvd (X_add_one_pow_dvd_G_T n) (x := (1 : ℤ))
  have h_pos := G_T_eval_one_pos n
  have h_two_pow_pos : (0 : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - n) := by positivity
  have := Int.le_of_dvd h_two_pow_pos h_eval_dvd
  have := Int.le_of_dvd h_pos h_two_pow_dvd
  linarith

name: numT_mul_G_T
statement:
lemma numT_mul_G_T (n : ℕ) :
    numT n * G_T n = ∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n, hPoly n lam
proof:
:= by
  have hmonic := G_T_monic n
  have hdvd : G_T n ∣ ∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n, hPoly n lam :=
    Finset.dvd_sum (fun _ hlam => Finset.gcd_dvd hlam)
  have heq := Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div
    (∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n, hPoly n lam) hmonic
  rw [(Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hmonic).mpr hdvd, zero_add] at heq
  rw [numT, mul_comm]
  exact heq

name: t_eq_sum
statement:
lemma t_eq_sum (n : ℕ) :
    t n = ∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n, (2 : ℤ) ^ (n - lam.parts.card)
proof:
:= by
  have hAn : n ≤ A n := n_le_A n
  have hne : ((2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - n)) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  have heval : (numT n).eval 1 * (G_T n).eval 1 =
      ∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n, (hPoly n lam).eval 1 := by
    have := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (1 : ℤ)) (numT_mul_G_T n)
    simpa [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum] using this
  rw [G_T_eval_one, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun lam hlam => hPoly_eval_one n lam hlam)] at heval
  have hfactor : ∀ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n,
      (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - lam.parts.card)
        = (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - n) * (2 : ℤ) ^ (n - lam.parts.card) := fun lam _ => by
    have hcard := partition_card_le n lam
    rw [← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hfactor, ← Finset.mul_sum] at heval
  have key : t n * (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - n)
      = (∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n, (2 : ℤ) ^ (n - lam.parts.card))
        * (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - n) := by
    show (numT n).eval 1 * (2 : ℤ) ^ (A n - n) = _
    rw [heval]
    ring
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hne key

name: addOne_mem_ternary
statement:
lemma addOne_mem_ternary (m : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition m)
    (hlam : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions m) : addOne m lam ∈ ternaryPartitions (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hlam ⊢
  intro i hi
  change i ∈ (1 ::ₘ lam.parts) at hi
  rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hi with rfl | h
  · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · exact hlam i h

name: one_mem_parts_of_ternary
statement:
lemma one_mem_parts_of_ternary (m : ℕ) (h : ¬ 3 ∣ (m + 1))
    (mu : Nat.Partition (m + 1)) (hmu : mu ∈ ternaryPartitions (m + 1)) :
    1 ∈ mu.parts
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h1
  apply h
  rw [← mu.parts_sum]
  have hternary : ∀ i ∈ mu.parts, ∃ k : ℕ, i = 3 ^ k := by
    simpa [ternaryPartitions] using hmu
  refine Multiset.dvd_sum (fun i hi => ?_)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hternary i hi
  subst hk
  rcases k with _ | k
  · simp at hi
    exact absurd hi h1
  · exact dvd_pow_self 3 (by omega)

name: addOne_injective
statement: lemma addOne_injective (m : ℕ) : Function.Injective (addOne m)
proof:
:= by
  intro lam₁ lam₂ h
  apply Nat.Partition.ext
  have h₂ : (1 ::ₘ lam₁.parts : Multiset ℕ) = (1 ::ₘ lam₂.parts : Multiset ℕ) := by
    simpa [addOne] using congrArg Nat.Partition.parts h
  simpa [Multiset.cons_inj_right] using h₂

name: addOne_surjective_on_ternary
statement:
lemma addOne_surjective_on_ternary (m : ℕ) (h : ¬ 3 ∣ (m + 1))
    (mu : Nat.Partition (m + 1)) (hmu : mu ∈ ternaryPartitions (m + 1)) :
    ∃ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions m, addOne m lam = mu
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 ∈ mu.parts := one_mem_parts_of_ternary m h mu hmu
  have hcons : (1 : ℕ) ::ₘ mu.parts.erase 1 = mu.parts := Multiset.cons_erase h1
  have hsum_m : (mu.parts.erase 1).sum = m := by
    have hs := mu.parts_sum
    have hcs : ((1 : ℕ) ::ₘ mu.parts.erase 1).sum = m + 1 := by rw [hcons]; exact hs
    rw [Multiset.sum_cons] at hcs
    omega
  have htern : ∀ i ∈ mu.parts, ∃ k : ℕ, i = 3 ^ k := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmu).2
  refine ⟨⟨mu.parts.erase 1, fun hi => mu.parts_pos (Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hi), hsum_m⟩,
    ?_, Nat.Partition.ext hcons⟩
  rw [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, fun i hi => htern i (Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hi)⟩

name: addOne_count_three_pow
statement:
lemma addOne_count_three_pow (m : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition m) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (addOne m lam).parts.count (3 ^ k) = lam.parts.count (3 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have h3_pow_ne_one : (3 : ℕ) ^ k ≠ 1 := by
    have : 1 < 3 ^ k := Nat.one_lt_pow (by omega) (by norm_num)
    omega
  grind [addOne.eq_def, Multiset.count_cons]

name: addOne_count_one
statement:
lemma addOne_count_one (m : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition m) :
    (addOne m lam).parts.count 1 = lam.parts.count 1 + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [addOne]

name: div_three_pow_succ_eq
statement:
lemma div_three_pow_succ_eq (m : ℕ) (h : ¬ 3 ∣ (m + 1)) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (m + 1) / 3 ^ k = m / 3 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction' hk with k _ IH
  · have hmod3 : (m + 1) / 3 = m / 3 := by omega
    simp [pow_one, hmod3]
  · rw [pow_succ, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, IH]

name: hPoly_addOne_top_factor
statement:
lemma hPoly_addOne_top_factor (m : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition m) :
    (1 + (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ (m + 1)))
        ^ ((m + 1) / 3 ^ (m + 1) - (addOne m lam).parts.count (3 ^ (m + 1))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : m + 1 < 3 ^ (m + 1) := Nat.lt_pow_self (by norm_num)
  have hdiv : (m + 1) / 3 ^ (m + 1) = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlt
  have hcount : (addOne m lam).parts.count (3 ^ (m + 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero]
    show 3 ^ (m + 1) ∉ (1 ::ₘ lam.parts : Multiset ℕ)
    intro hmem
    rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hmem with h | h
    · omega
    · have hle : 3 ^ (m + 1) ≤ lam.parts.sum := Multiset.le_sum_of_mem h
      rw [lam.parts_sum] at hle
      omega
  simp [hdiv, hcount]

name: hPoly_addOne_eq
statement:
lemma hPoly_addOne_eq (m : ℕ) (h : ¬ 3 ∣ (m + 1)) (lam : Nat.Partition m) :
    hPoly (m + 1) (addOne m lam) = hPoly m lam
proof:
:= by
  unfold hPoly
  rw [show m + 1 + 1 = (m + 1) + 1 from rfl, Finset.prod_range_succ,
    hPoly_addOne_top_factor m lam, mul_one]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk1
  · rw [pow_zero] at *
    have hcount : lam.parts.count 1 ≤ m := by
      simpa [lam.parts_sum] using count_mul_le_sum_aux lam.parts 1
    rw [addOne_count_one m lam,
      show (m + 1) / 1 - (lam.parts.count 1 + 1) = m / 1 - lam.parts.count 1 by
        rw [Nat.div_one, Nat.div_one]; omega]
  · rw [div_three_pow_succ_eq m h k hk1, addOne_count_three_pow m lam k hk1]

name: sum_hPoly_succ_eq
statement:
lemma sum_hPoly_succ_eq (m : ℕ) (h : ¬ 3 ∣ (m + 1)) :
    (∑ mu ∈ ternaryPartitions (m + 1), hPoly (m + 1) mu)
      = ∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions m, hPoly m lam
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_bij
    (fun (lam : Nat.Partition m) (_ : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions m) => addOne m lam)
  · exact fun a ha => addOne_mem_ternary m a ha
  · exact fun a₁ _ a₂ _ heq => addOne_injective m heq
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩ := addOne_surjective_on_ternary m h b hb
    exact ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩
  · exact fun a _ => (hPoly_addOne_eq m h a).symm

name: G_T_succ_dvd_G_T
statement:
lemma G_T_succ_dvd_G_T (m : ℕ) (h : ¬ 3 ∣ (m + 1)) :
    G_T (m + 1) ∣ G_T m
proof:
:=
  Finset.dvd_gcd fun lam hlam => by
    rw [← hPoly_addOne_eq m h lam]
    exact Finset.gcd_dvd (addOne_mem_ternary m lam hlam)

name: G_T_dvd_G_T_succ
statement:
lemma G_T_dvd_G_T_succ (m : ℕ) (h : ¬ 3 ∣ (m + 1)) :
    G_T m ∣ G_T (m + 1)
proof:
:=
  Finset.dvd_gcd fun mu hmu => by
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam, rfl⟩ := addOne_surjective_on_ternary m h mu hmu
    rw [hPoly_addOne_eq m h lam]
    exact Finset.gcd_dvd hlam

name: t_succ_eq
statement: lemma t_succ_eq (m : ℕ) (h : ¬ 3 ∣ (m + 1)) : t m = t (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : G_T (m + 1) = G_T m := by
    have h1 := G_T_succ_dvd_G_T m h
    have h2 := G_T_dvd_G_T_succ m h
    have hp := G_T_monic (m + 1)
    have hq := G_T_monic m
    have hd : (G_T (m + 1)).natDegree = (G_T m).natDegree :=
      le_antisymm (Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd h1 hq.ne_zero)
        (Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd h2 hp.ne_zero)
    exact (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hp hq h1 hd.ge).symm
  unfold t numT
  rw [sum_hPoly_succ_eq m h, hG]

name: addThreeOnes_card
statement:
lemma addThreeOnes_card (k : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition (3 * k)) :
    (addThreeOnes k lam).parts.card = lam.parts.card + 3
proof:
:= by
  simp [addThreeOnes]

name: addThreeOnes_mem_ternary
statement:
lemma addThreeOnes_mem_ternary (k : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition (3 * k))
    (hlam : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * k)) :
    addThreeOnes k lam ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hlam ⊢
  intro i hi
  change i ∈ (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ lam.parts) at hi
  simp only [Multiset.mem_cons] at hi
  rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl | h
  · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · exact hlam i h

name: addThreeOnes_one_mem
statement:
lemma addThreeOnes_one_mem (k : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition (3 * k)) :
    1 ∈ (addThreeOnes k lam).parts
proof:
:=
  Multiset.mem_cons_self 1 _

name: addThreeOnes_injective
statement: lemma addThreeOnes_injective (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (addThreeOnes k)
proof:
:= by
  intro lam₁ lam₂ h
  apply Nat.Partition.ext
  have hparts : (1 : ℕ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ lam₁.parts = 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ lam₂.parts :=
    congrArg Nat.Partition.parts h
  simpa [Multiset.cons_inj_right] using hparts

name: three_dvd_sum_parts_ne_one
statement:
lemma three_dvd_sum_parts_ne_one (n : ℕ) (μ : Nat.Partition n)
    (hμ : μ ∈ ternaryPartitions n) :
    3 ∣ (μ.parts.filter (fun x => x ≠ 1)).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hμ
  refine Multiset.dvd_sum fun i hi => ?_
  rw [Multiset.mem_filter] at hi
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hμ i hi.1
  subst hk
  rcases k with _ | k
  · simp at hi
  · exact dvd_pow_self 3 (by omega)

name: count_one_ge_three
statement:
lemma count_one_ge_three (n : ℕ) (μ : Nat.Partition (3 * n))
    (hμ : μ ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * n))
    (h1 : 1 ∈ μ.parts) : 3 ≤ μ.parts.count 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :
      (μ.parts.filter (fun x => x = 1)).sum
        + (μ.parts.filter (fun x => ¬ x = 1)).sum = μ.parts.sum :=
    Multiset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := μ.parts) (fun x => x = 1)
  have hfilter_eq : (μ.parts.filter (fun x => x = 1)).sum = μ.parts.count 1 := by
    rw [Multiset.filter_eq', Multiset.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hrest : 3 ∣ (μ.parts.filter (fun x => ¬ x = 1)).sum := by
    convert three_dvd_sum_parts_ne_one (3 * n) μ hμ using 2
  have h3sum : (3 : ℕ) ∣ μ.parts.sum := by rw [μ.parts_sum]; exact ⟨n, rfl⟩
  have h3c : (3 : ℕ) ∣ μ.parts.count 1 := by
    have : (3 : ℕ) ∣ μ.parts.count 1 + (μ.parts.filter (fun x => ¬ x = 1)).sum := by
      rw [← hfilter_eq, hsplit]
      exact h3sum
    omega
  have hge1 : 1 ≤ μ.parts.count 1 := Multiset.one_le_count_iff_mem.mpr h1
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h3c
  omega

name: sub_three_ones_sum
statement:
lemma sub_three_ones_sum (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h : 3 ≤ μ.count 1) :
    (μ - (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 0)).sum = μ.sum - 3
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 ∈ μ := Multiset.count_pos.mp (by omega)
  have h2 : 1 ∈ μ.erase 1 := Multiset.count_pos.mp (by rw [Multiset.count_erase_self]; omega)
  have h3 : 1 ∈ (μ.erase 1).erase 1 := Multiset.count_pos.mp (by
    rw [Multiset.count_erase_self, Multiset.count_erase_self]; omega)
  simp only [Multiset.sub_cons, Multiset.sub_zero]
  have s1 := (Multiset.sum_erase h1).symm
  have s2 := (Multiset.sum_erase h2).symm
  have s3 := (Multiset.sum_erase h3).symm
  omega

name: cons_three_ones_sub
statement:
lemma cons_three_ones_sub (μ : Multiset ℕ) (h : 3 ≤ μ.count 1) :
    (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (μ - (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 0))) = μ
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (0 : Multiset ℕ)) ≤ μ := by
    show Multiset.replicate 3 1 ≤ μ
    exact Multiset.le_count_iff_replicate_le.mp h
  have hcons : ∀ (x : Multiset ℕ),
      (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ x) = (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (0 : Multiset ℕ)) + x := fun x => by
    simp [Multiset.cons_add]
  rw [hcons, add_comm]
  exact Multiset.sub_add_cancel hle

name: addThreeOnes_surjective
statement:
lemma addThreeOnes_surjective (k : ℕ) (μ : Nat.Partition (3 * (k + 1)))
    (hμ : μ ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * (k + 1)))
    (h1 : 1 ∈ μ.parts) :
    ∃ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * k), addThreeOnes k lam = μ
proof:
:= by
  have hcnt : 3 ≤ μ.parts.count 1 := count_one_ge_three (k + 1) μ hμ h1
  set lam_parts : Multiset ℕ := μ.parts - (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 0) with hlam_parts
  have hsum : lam_parts.sum = 3 * k := by
    rw [hlam_parts, sub_three_ones_sum μ.parts hcnt, μ.parts_sum]
    omega
  have hpos : ∀ i ∈ lam_parts, 0 < i := fun i hi =>
    μ.parts_pos (Multiset.mem_of_le (Multiset.sub_le_self _ _) hi)
  have hpow : ∀ i ∈ lam_parts, ∃ k' : ℕ, i = 3 ^ k' := fun i hi =>
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hμ).2 i (Multiset.mem_of_le (Multiset.sub_le_self _ _) hi)
  refine ⟨⟨lam_parts, fun {i} hi => hpos i hi, hsum⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact hpow
  · apply Nat.Partition.ext
    show (1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ lam_parts) = μ.parts
    rw [hlam_parts]
    exact cons_three_ones_sub μ.parts hcnt

name: sum_with_one_eq_pred_sum
statement:
lemma sum_with_one_eq_pred_sum (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ μ ∈ (ternaryPartitions (3 * n)).filter (fun μ => 1 ∈ μ.parts),
        (2 : ℤ) ^ (3 * n - μ.parts.card))
      = ∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * (n - 1)),
          (2 : ℤ) ^ (3 * (n - 1) - lam.parts.card)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  show (∑ μ ∈ (ternaryPartitions (3 * (k + 1))).filter (fun μ => 1 ∈ μ.parts),
          (2 : ℤ) ^ (3 * (k + 1) - μ.parts.card))
        = ∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * k),
            (2 : ℤ) ^ (3 * k - lam.parts.card)
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun lam _ => addThreeOnes k lam)
  · intro lam hlam
    rw [Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨addThreeOnes_mem_ternary k lam hlam, addThreeOnes_one_mem k lam⟩
  · exact fun a _ b _ h => addThreeOnes_injective k h
  · intro μ hμ
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hμ
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩ := addThreeOnes_surjective k μ hμ.1 hμ.2
    exact ⟨lam, hlam, heq⟩
  · intro lam _
    rw [addThreeOnes_card]
    have hcard : lam.parts.card ≤ 3 * k := partition_card_le (3 * k) lam
    congr 1
    omega

name: mulThree_card
statement:
lemma mulThree_card (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n) :
    (mulThree n lam).parts.card = lam.parts.card
proof:
:= by
  show (lam.parts.map (· * 3)).card = lam.parts.card
  simp

name: mulThree_injective
statement: lemma mulThree_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (mulThree n)
proof:
:= by
  intro lam1 lam2 h
  apply Nat.Partition.ext
  exact Multiset.map_injective
    (fun a b hab => by simpa using Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (by norm_num : (0 : ℕ) < 3) hab)
    (congrArg Nat.Partition.parts h)

name: mulThree_mem
statement:
lemma mulThree_mem (n : ℕ) (lam : Nat.Partition n) (h : lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n) :
    mulThree n lam ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * n) ∧ 1 ∉ (mulThree n lam).parts
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    intro i hi
    rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hi with ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h j hj
    exact ⟨k + 1, by rw [hk]; ring⟩
  · intro hcontra
    rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hcontra with ⟨j, _, hj_eq⟩
    omega

name: mulThree_surj.part_div_three
statement:
lemma mulThree_surj.part_div_three (n : ℕ) (mu : Nat.Partition (3 * n))
    (hmu : mu ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * n)) (hno : 1 ∉ mu.parts)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ mu.parts) : 3 ∣ i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hmu
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hmu i hi
  rcases k with _ | k
  · simp at hk
    exact absurd (hk ▸ hi) hno
  · exact hk ▸ dvd_pow_self 3 (by omega)

name: mulThree_surj.divThree_isPartition
statement:
lemma mulThree_surj.divThree_isPartition (n : ℕ) (mu : Nat.Partition (3 * n))
    (hmu : mu ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * n)) (hno : 1 ∉ mu.parts) :
    (∀ i ∈ mu.parts.map (· / 3), 0 < i) ∧ (mu.parts.map (· / 3)).sum = n
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv : ∀ i ∈ mu.parts, 3 ∣ i :=
    fun i hi => mulThree_surj.part_div_three n mu hmu hno i hi
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hj with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (mu.parts_pos hi) (hdiv i hi)) (by norm_num)
  · have heq : mu.parts = mu.parts.map (fun i => 3 * (i / 3)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Multiset.map_id mu.parts]
      exact Multiset.map_congr rfl (fun i hi => by simp [Nat.mul_div_cancel' (hdiv i hi)])
    have hsum2 : mu.parts.sum = 3 * (mu.parts.map (· / 3)).sum := by
      conv_lhs => rw [heq]
      exact Multiset.sum_map_mul_left
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by norm_num : 0 < 3) (by rw [← hsum2, mu.parts_sum])

name: div_three_pow_is_pow_three
statement:
lemma div_three_pow_is_pow_three (i : ℕ) (hi : ∃ k' : ℕ, i = 3 ^ k') (hne : i ≠ 1) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, i / 3 = 3 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hi
  have hk0 : k' ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (by rw [hk', h, pow_zero])
  refine ⟨k' - 1, ?_⟩
  rw [hk']
  conv_lhs => rw [show k' = (k' - 1) + 1 from by omega, pow_succ]
  exact Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (by norm_num : 0 < 3)

name: mulThree_surj.divThree_mem_ternary
statement:
lemma mulThree_surj.divThree_mem_ternary (n : ℕ) (mu : Nat.Partition (3 * n))
    (hmu : mu ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * n)) (hno : 1 ∉ mu.parts) :
    mulThree_surj.divThree n mu hmu hno ∈ ternaryPartitions n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  intro j hj
  change j ∈ mu.parts.map (· / 3) at hj
  rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hj with ⟨i, hi_mem, rfl⟩
  exact div_three_pow_is_pow_three i ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hmu).2 i hi_mem)
    (fun heq => hno (heq ▸ hi_mem))

name: mulThree_surj.mulThree_divThree
statement:
lemma mulThree_surj.mulThree_divThree (n : ℕ) (mu : Nat.Partition (3 * n))
    (hmu : mu ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * n)) (hno : 1 ∉ mu.parts) :
    mulThree n (mulThree_surj.divThree n mu hmu hno) = mu
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.Partition.ext
  show (mu.parts.map (· / 3)).map (· * 3) = mu.parts
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Multiset.map_id' mu.parts]
  exact Multiset.map_congr rfl fun i hi =>
    Nat.div_mul_cancel (mulThree_surj.part_div_three n mu hmu hno i hi)

name: mulThree_surj
statement:
lemma mulThree_surj (n : ℕ) (mu : Nat.Partition (3 * n))
    (hmu : mu ∈ ternaryPartitions (3 * n)) (hno : 1 ∉ mu.parts) :
    ∃ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n, mulThree n lam = mu
proof:
:=
  ⟨mulThree_surj.divThree n mu hmu hno,
   mulThree_surj.divThree_mem_ternary n mu hmu hno,
   mulThree_surj.mulThree_divThree n mu hmu hno⟩

name: sum_no_one_eq_sum_T_n
statement:
lemma sum_no_one_eq_sum_T_n (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ μ ∈ (ternaryPartitions (3 * n)).filter (fun μ => 1 ∉ μ.parts),
        (2 : ℤ) ^ (3 * n - μ.parts.card))
      = ∑ lam ∈ ternaryPartitions n, (2 : ℤ) ^ (3 * n - lam.parts.card)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun lam _ => mulThree n lam) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro lam hlam
    rw [Finset.mem_filter]
    exact mulThree_mem n lam hlam
  · exact fun _ _ _ _ h => mulThree_injective n h
  · intro mu hmu
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hmu
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam_T, hlam_eq⟩ := mulThree_surj n mu hmu.1 hmu.2
    exact ⟨lam, hlam_T, hlam_eq⟩
  · intro lam _
    rw [mulThree_card]

name: sum_no_one_eq
statement:
lemma sum_no_one_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ μ ∈ (ternaryPartitions (3 * n)).filter (fun μ => 1 ∉ μ.parts),
        (2 : ℤ) ^ (3 * n - μ.parts.card))
      = 2 ^ (2 * n) * t n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_no_one_eq_sum_T_n, t_eq_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun lam _ => ?_)
  have hcard := partition_card_le n lam
  rw [← pow_add]
  congr 1
  omega

name: t_recurrence_alt
statement:
lemma t_recurrence_alt (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    t (3 * n) - t (3 * (n - 1)) = 2 ^ (2 * n) * t n
proof:
:= by
  rw [t_eq_sum (3 * n),
    ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := ternaryPartitions (3 * n))
      (p := fun μ : Nat.Partition (3 * n) => 1 ∈ μ.parts)
      (f := fun μ : Nat.Partition (3 * n) => (2 : ℤ) ^ (3 * n - μ.parts.card)),
    sum_with_one_eq_pred_sum n hn, t_eq_sum (3 * (n - 1)), sum_no_one_eq n]
  ring

name: t_eq_three_mod
statement:
theorem t_eq_three_mod (n : ℕ) :
    t (3 * n) = t (3 * n + 1) ∧ t (3 * n + 1) = t (3 * n + 2)
proof:
:=
  ⟨t_succ_eq (3 * n) (by omega), t_succ_eq (3 * n + 1) (by omega)⟩

name: t_recurrence
statement:
theorem t_recurrence (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    t (3 * n) - t (3 * n - 2) = 2 ^ (2 * n) * t n
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 3 * n - 2 = 3 * (n - 1) + 1 by omega, ← t_succ_eq (3 * (n - 1)) (by omega)]
  exact t_recurrence_alt n hn

name: Conj9.allOnesPart_mem_ternary
statement:
lemma allOnesPart_mem_ternary (m : ℕ) :
    allOnesPart m ∈ ternaryPartitions m
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have h : i = 1 := by
    rw [allOnesPart] at hi
    simp only [Multiset.mem_replicate] at hi
    aesop
  exact ⟨0, by norm_num, by simp [h]⟩

name: Conj9.Aux_card_parts_lt_of_ne_allOnes.multiset_card_le_sum
statement:
lemma multiset_card_le_sum (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : ∀ a ∈ s, 1 ≤ a) :
    s.card ≤ s.sum
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.card_cons, Multiset.sum_cons]
    have ha : 1 ≤ a := h a (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _)
    have hs : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ x := fun x hx => h x (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hx)
    linarith [ih hs]

name: Conj9.Aux_card_parts_lt_of_ne_allOnes.partition_card_le
statement: lemma partition_card_le (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) : p.parts.card ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : p.parts.sum = m := p.parts_sum
  have h2 : ∀ a ∈ p.parts, 1 ≤ a := fun a ha => p.parts_pos ha
  calc p.parts.card ≤ p.parts.sum := multiset_card_le_sum _ h2
    _ = m := h1

name: Conj9.Aux_card_parts_lt_of_ne_allOnes.parts_eq_replicate_of_all_one
statement:
lemma parts_eq_replicate_of_all_one (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ p.parts, i = 1) : p.parts = Multiset.replicate m 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : p.parts.sum = m := p.parts_sum
  have hreplicate : p.parts = Multiset.replicate (Multiset.card p.parts) 1 := by
    refine Multiset.eq_replicate_card.mpr ?_
    intro b hb
    exact h b hb
  have hcard : Multiset.card p.parts = m := by
    have hh : p.parts.sum = Multiset.card p.parts := by
      rw [hreplicate]; simp
    omega
  rw [hreplicate, hcard]

name: Conj9.Aux_card_parts_lt_of_ne_allOnes.all_parts_one_of_card_eq
statement:
lemma all_parts_one_of_card_eq (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m)
    (h : p.parts.card = m) : ∀ i ∈ p.parts, i = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : p.parts.sum = m := p.parts_sum
  have hpos : ∀ a ∈ p.parts, 1 ≤ a := fun a ha => p.parts_pos ha
  intro i hi
  by_contra hne
  have hi1 : 1 ≤ i := hpos i hi
  have hi2 : 2 ≤ i := by omega
  classical
  have hcons : i ::ₘ p.parts.erase i = p.parts := Multiset.cons_erase hi
  set t := p.parts.erase i with ht
  have hcard : t.card = m - 1 := by
    have h1 := Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hi
    rw [h, Nat.pred_eq_sub_one] at h1
    rw [ht]; exact h1
  have hsum_split : t.sum + i = m := by
    have heq : (i ::ₘ t).sum = p.parts.sum := by rw [hcons]
    rw [Multiset.sum_cons, hsum] at heq
    omega
  have ht_pos : ∀ a ∈ t, 1 ≤ a := by
    intro a ha
    apply hpos a
    rw [← hcons]
    exact Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem ha
  have ht_card_le : t.card ≤ t.sum := multiset_card_le_sum t ht_pos
  have hm_pos : 1 ≤ m := by
    have hne0 : p.parts ≠ 0 := fun heq => by simp [heq] at hi
    have : 1 ≤ p.parts.card := Multiset.card_pos.mpr hne0
    omega
  omega

name: Conj9.Aux_card_parts_lt_of_ne_allOnes.eq_allOnes_of_parts_eq
statement:
lemma eq_allOnes_of_parts_eq (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m)
    (h : p.parts = Multiset.replicate m 1) : p = allOnesPart m
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.Partition.ext
  simp_all [allOnesPart]

name: Conj9.Aux_card_parts_lt_of_ne_allOnes.card_parts_lt_of_ne_allOnes
statement:
lemma card_parts_lt_of_ne_allOnes (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m)
    (_hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) (hne : p ≠ allOnesPart m) :
    p.parts.card < m
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (partition_card_le m p) with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd (eq_allOnes_of_parts_eq m p
      (parts_eq_replicate_of_all_one m p (all_parts_one_of_card_eq m p h))) hne

name: Conj9.Aux_gcdHTernary_monic.allOnesPart_mem_ternary
statement:
lemma allOnesPart_mem_ternary (m : ℕ) :
    allOnesPart m ∈ ternaryPartitions m
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have h : i = 1 := by
    rw [allOnesPart] at hi
    simp only [Multiset.mem_replicate] at hi
    aesop
  exact ⟨0, by norm_num, by simp [h]⟩

name: Conj9.Aux_gcdHTernary_monic.monic_one_add_X_pow_three_pow
statement:
lemma monic_one_add_X_pow_three_pow (k : ℕ) :
    (1 + Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) : Polynomial ℤ).Monic
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (1 + Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) : Polynomial ℤ) = Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) + 1 from by ring]
  apply Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add
  simp [pow_pos]

name: Conj9.Aux_gcdHTernary_monic.hTernary_monic
statement:
lemma hTernary_monic (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) :
    (hTernary m p).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold hTernary
  apply Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic
  intro k _
  exact (monic_one_add_X_pow_three_pow k).pow _

name: Conj9.Aux_gcdHTernary_monic.leadingCoeff_pos_of_normalize_eq_self
statement:
lemma leadingCoeff_pos_of_normalize_eq_self
    {g : Polynomial ℤ} (hnorm : normalize g = g) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    0 < g.leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have hlc : g.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hg
  have hnorm_lc : normalize g.leadingCoeff = g.leadingCoeff := by
    have := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_normalize g
    rw [hnorm] at this
    exact this.symm
  have h0 : 0 ≤ g.leadingCoeff := Int.nonneg_of_normalize_eq_self hnorm_lc
  exact h0.lt_of_ne (Ne.symm hlc)

name: Conj9.Aux_gcdHTernary_monic.monic_of_normalize_eq_self_of_dvd_monic
statement:
lemma monic_of_normalize_eq_self_of_dvd_monic
    {g p : Polynomial ℤ} (hnorm : normalize g = g)
    (hdvd : g ∣ p) (hp : p.Monic) : g.Monic
proof:
:= by
  have hp_ne : p ≠ 0 := hp.ne_zero
  have hg_ne : g ≠ 0 := fun h => hp_ne (by rw [h] at hdvd; exact zero_dvd_iff.mp hdvd)
  have hlc_dvd : g.leadingCoeff ∣ (1 : ℤ) := by
    have := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_dvd_leadingCoeff hdvd
    rwa [hp.leadingCoeff] at this
  have hlc_unit : IsUnit g.leadingCoeff := isUnit_of_dvd_one hlc_dvd
  have hlc_cases : g.leadingCoeff = 1 ∨ g.leadingCoeff = -1 := Int.isUnit_iff.mp hlc_unit
  have hlc_pos : 0 < g.leadingCoeff :=
    leadingCoeff_pos_of_normalize_eq_self hnorm hg_ne
  rcases hlc_cases with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso; rw [h] at hlc_pos; norm_num at hlc_pos

name: Conj9.Aux_gcdHTernary_monic.normalize_finset_gcd_polynomial_int
statement:
lemma normalize_finset_gcd_polynomial_int
    {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → Polynomial ℤ) :
    normalize (s.gcd f) = s.gcd f
proof:
:=
  Finset.normalize_gcd

name: Conj9.Aux_gcdHTernary_monic.finset_gcd_monic_of_forall_monic
statement:
lemma finset_gcd_monic_of_forall_monic
    {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (f : α → Polynomial ℤ) (hmon : ∀ a ∈ s, (f a).Monic) :
    (s.gcd f).Monic
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := hs
  have hdvd : s.gcd f ∣ f a₀ := Finset.gcd_dvd ha₀
  have hnorm : normalize (s.gcd f) = s.gcd f :=
    normalize_finset_gcd_polynomial_int s f
  exact monic_of_normalize_eq_self_of_dvd_monic hnorm hdvd (hmon a₀ ha₀)

name: Conj9.Aux_gcdHTernary_monic.gcdHTernary_monic
statement: lemma gcdHTernary_monic (m : ℕ) : (gcdHTernary m).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold gcdHTernary
  exact finset_gcd_monic_of_forall_monic
    (ternaryPartitions m)
    ⟨allOnesPart m, allOnesPart_mem_ternary m⟩
    (hTernary m)
    (fun p _ => hTernary_monic m p)

name: Conj9.Aux_numT_eq_sum_divByMonic.gcdHTernary_dvd_hTernary
statement:
lemma gcdHTernary_dvd_hTernary (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m)
    (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    gcdHTernary m ∣ hTernary m p
proof:
:=
  Finset.gcd_dvd hp

name: Conj9.Aux_numT_eq_sum_divByMonic.eq_divByMonic_mul_of_dvd
statement:
lemma eq_divByMonic_mul_of_dvd
    (p g : Polynomial ℤ) (hg : g.Monic) (hd : g ∣ p) :
    p = (p /ₘ g) * g
proof:
:= by
  have h_mod : p %ₘ g = 0 := (Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hg).mpr hd
  have h_sum : p %ₘ g + g * (p /ₘ g) = p := Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div p hg
  rw [h_mod, zero_add, mul_comm] at h_sum
  exact h_sum.symm

name: Conj9.Aux_numT_eq_sum_divByMonic.mul_divByMonic_self
statement:
lemma mul_divByMonic_self
    (q g : Polynomial ℤ) (hg : g.Monic) : (q * g) /ₘ g = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact Polynomial.mul_divByMonic_cancel_left _ hg

name: Conj9.Aux_numT_eq_sum_divByMonic.sum_divByMonic_of_dvd
statement:
lemma sum_divByMonic_of_dvd {α : Type*} (S : Finset α)
    (f : α → Polynomial ℤ) (g : Polynomial ℤ)
    (hg : g.Monic) (hdvd : ∀ a ∈ S, g ∣ f a) :
    (∑ a ∈ S, f a) /ₘ g = ∑ a ∈ S, (f a /ₘ g)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ a ∈ S, f a) = (∑ a ∈ S, f a /ₘ g) * g := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro a ha
    exact eq_divByMonic_mul_of_dvd (f a) g hg (hdvd a ha)
  rw [hsum]
  exact mul_divByMonic_self _ g hg

name: Conj9.Aux_numT_eq_sum_divByMonic.numT_eq_sum_divByMonic
statement:
lemma numT_eq_sum_divByMonic (m : ℕ) :
    numT m = ∑ p ∈ ternaryPartitions m, (hTernary m p /ₘ gcdHTernary m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold numT
  exact sum_divByMonic_of_dvd (ternaryPartitions m) (hTernary m) (gcdHTernary m)
    (gcdHTernary_monic m) (fun p hp => gcdHTernary_dvd_hTernary m p hp)

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.gcdHTernary_monic
statement: lemma gcdHTernary_monic (m : ℕ) : (gcdHTernary m).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold gcdHTernary
  apply finset_gcd_monic_of_forall_monic
  · refine ⟨allOnesPart m, ?_⟩
    simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    intro i hi
    show IsPow3 i
    simp only [allOnesPart, Multiset.mem_replicate] at hi
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [hi.2]
    · simp [hi.2]
  · intro p _
    exact hTernary_monic m p

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.cofactorAdd_eq_sum_neg_X_pow
statement:
lemma cofactorAdd_eq_sum_neg_X_pow (N : ℕ) :
    cofactorAdd N = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (-Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ i
proof:
:= by
  unfold cofactorAdd
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [neg_pow]
  ring

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.three_pow_odd
statement: lemma three_pow_odd (k : ℕ) : Odd ((3 : ℕ) ^ k)
proof: := Odd.pow ⟨1, rfl⟩

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.one_add_X_pow_three_pow_eq_X_add_one_mul
statement:
lemma one_add_X_pow_three_pow_eq_X_add_one_mul (k : ℕ) :
    (1 + Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) : Polynomial ℤ)
      = (Polynomial.X + 1) * cofactorAdd (3 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hodd : Odd ((3 : ℕ) ^ k) := three_pow_odd k
  rw [cofactorAdd_eq_sum_neg_X_pow]
  have h := geom_sum_mul_neg (-Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) (3 ^ k)
  have hneg_pow : (-Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k) = -Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) :=
    hodd.neg_pow _
  rw [hneg_pow] at h
  have h1 : (1 : Polynomial ℤ) - (-Polynomial.X) = Polynomial.X + 1 := by ring
  have h2 : (1 : Polynomial ℤ) - (-(Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k))) = 1 + Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) := by
    ring
  rw [h1, h2] at h
  linear_combination -h

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.hTernary_eq_X_add_one_pow_mul_cofactor
statement:
lemma hTernary_eq_X_add_one_pow_mul_cofactor (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) :
    hTernary m p
      = (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (expSum m p) * (hTernaryCofactor m p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hTernary hTernaryCofactor expSum
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun k _ => by
      rw [one_add_X_pow_three_pow_eq_X_add_one_mul k, mul_pow])]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  rw [← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.exists_exp_of_mem_parts_ternary
statement:
lemma exists_exp_of_mem_parts_ternary {m : ℕ} (p : Nat.Partition m)
    (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) (a : ℕ) (ha : a ∈ p.parts) :
    ∃ k, k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1) ∧ 3 ^ k = a
proof:
:= by
  have hp_ternary : IsTernary p := by
    simp [ternaryPartitions] at hp; exact hp
  obtain ⟨k, hka, hak⟩ := hp_ternary a ha
  refine ⟨k, ?_, hak.symm⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_range]
  have ha_le_sum : a ≤ p.parts.sum :=
    Multiset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) a ha
  rw [p.parts_sum] at ha_le_sum
  omega

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.card_parts_eq_sum_partMult
statement:
lemma card_parts_eq_sum_partMult
    (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    p.parts.card = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), partMult p (3 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : p.parts.card = ∑ a ∈ p.parts.toFinset, partMult p a :=
    (Multiset.toFinset_sum_count_eq p.parts).symm
  rw [h1]
  symm
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_of_ne (p := fun k => 3 ^ k ∈ p.parts.toFinset)
    (s := Finset.range (m + 1)) (f := fun k => partMult p (3 ^ k))]
  · apply Finset.sum_bij (fun (k : ℕ) (_ : k ∈ (Finset.range (m + 1)).filter
      (fun k => 3 ^ k ∈ p.parts.toFinset)) => (3 ^ k : ℕ))
    · intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hk
      exact hk.2
    · intro k₁ _ k₂ _ heq
      exact Nat.pow_right_injective (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3) heq
    · intro a ha
      have hap : a ∈ p.parts := Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp ha
      obtain ⟨k, hkR, hak⟩ := exists_exp_of_mem_parts_ternary p hp a hap
      refine ⟨k, ?_, hak⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨hkR, ?_⟩
      rw [hak]; exact ha
    · intro k _
      rfl
  · intro k _ hk
    have hcount : p.parts.count (3 ^ k) ≠ 0 := hk
    exact Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr (Multiset.count_pos.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hcount))

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.partMult_mul_three_pow_le
statement:
lemma partMult_mul_three_pow_le
    (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) (k : ℕ) :
    partMult p (3 ^ k) * 3 ^ k ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  unfold partMult
  have h_repl_le : Multiset.replicate (p.parts.count (3 ^ k)) (3 ^ k) ≤ p.parts :=
    Multiset.le_iff_count.mpr (fun b => by
      by_cases hb : b = 3 ^ k
      · subst hb; simp
      · rw [Multiset.count_replicate]
        simp [Ne.symm hb])
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mp h_repl_le
  have hsum : p.parts.sum = m := p.parts_sum
  rw [hu] at hsum
  simp [Multiset.sum_replicate] at hsum
  omega

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.partMult_le_m_div_three_pow
statement:
lemma partMult_le_m_div_three_pow
    (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) (k : ℕ) :
    partMult p (3 ^ k) ≤ m / 3 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (3 : ℕ) ^ k := pow_pos (by norm_num) k
  exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hpos).mpr (partMult_mul_three_pow_le m p k)

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.expSum_eq_sigmaM_sub_card
statement:
lemma expSum_eq_sigmaM_sub_card
    (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    expSum m p = sigmaM m - p.parts.card
proof:
:= by
  unfold expSum sigmaM
  have hle : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      partMult p (3 ^ k) ≤ m / 3 ^ k := by
    intro k _hk
    exact partMult_le_m_div_three_pow m p k
  rw [Finset.sum_tsub_distrib _ hle]
  rw [← card_parts_eq_sum_partMult m p hp]

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.card_parts_le
statement: lemma card_parts_le (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) : p.parts.card ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : p.parts.sum = m := p.parts_sum
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ p.parts, 1 ≤ x := fun x hx => p.parts_pos hx
  have hle : p.parts.card • 1 ≤ p.parts.sum := Multiset.card_nsmul_le_sum hpos
  simp at hle
  rwa [hsum] at hle

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.m_le_sigmaM
statement: lemma m_le_sigmaM (m : ℕ) : m ≤ sigmaM m
proof:
:= by
  calc
    m = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 1, m / 3 ^ k := by
      simp
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), m / 3 ^ k := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢
        omega
      · intro x _ _
        simp
    _ = sigmaM m := by
      rfl

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.gcdHTernary_dvd_hTernary
statement:
lemma gcdHTernary_dvd_hTernary (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m)
    (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    gcdHTernary m ∣ hTernary m p
proof:
:= by
  unfold gcdHTernary
  exact Finset.gcd_dvd hp

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.allOnesPart_card
statement: lemma allOnesPart_card (m : ℕ) : (allOnesPart m).parts.card = m
proof:
:= by
  show (Multiset.replicate m 1).card = m
  exact Multiset.card_replicate m 1

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.partMult_allOnes_one
statement:
lemma partMult_allOnes_one (m : ℕ) :
    partMult (allOnesPart m) 1 = m
proof:
:= by
  unfold partMult allOnesPart
  simp [Multiset.count_replicate_self]

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.partMult_allOnes_three_pow_ge_one
statement:
lemma partMult_allOnes_three_pow_ge_one (m k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    partMult (allOnesPart m) (3 ^ k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold partMult allOnesPart
  simp only [Multiset.count_replicate]
  have h3 : 3 ^ k ≥ 3 := by
    calc 3 ^ k ≥ 3 ^ 1 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hk
      _ = 3 := by norm_num
  have : ¬ (1 = 3 ^ k) := by omega
  simp [this]

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.X_add_one_pow_sigmaM_sub_m_dvd_hTernary
statement:
lemma X_add_one_pow_sigmaM_sub_m_dvd_hTernary
    (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    (Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (sigmaM m - m) ∣ hTernary m p
proof:
:= by
  rw [hTernary_eq_X_add_one_pow_mul_cofactor]
  rw [expSum_eq_sigmaM_sub_card m p hp]
  refine Dvd.dvd.mul_right ?_ _
  apply pow_dvd_pow
  exact Nat.sub_le_sub_left (card_parts_le m p) (sigmaM m)

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.X_add_one_pow_sigmaM_sub_m_dvd_gcdHTernary
statement:
lemma X_add_one_pow_sigmaM_sub_m_dvd_gcdHTernary (m : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (sigmaM m - m) ∣ gcdHTernary m
proof:
:= by
  unfold gcdHTernary
  exact Finset.dvd_gcd (fun p hp => X_add_one_pow_sigmaM_sub_m_dvd_hTernary m p hp)

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.gcdHTernary_eq_X_add_one_pow_mul_gcdRemainder
statement:
lemma gcdHTernary_eq_X_add_one_pow_mul_gcdRemainder (m : ℕ) :
    gcdHTernary m
      = (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (sigmaM m - m) * gcdRemainder m
proof:
:= by
  have hX1 : ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) + 1).Monic := by
    simpa using (Polynomial.monic_X_add_C (1 : ℤ))
  have hpow : ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (sigmaM m - m)).Monic :=
    hX1.pow _
  have hdvd : (Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (sigmaM m - m) ∣ gcdHTernary m :=
    X_add_one_pow_sigmaM_sub_m_dvd_gcdHTernary m
  have hmod : gcdHTernary m %ₘ ((Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (sigmaM m - m)) = 0 :=
    (Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hpow).mpr hdvd
  have key := Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div (gcdHTernary m) hpow
  rw [hmod, zero_add] at key
  show gcdHTernary m = (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (sigmaM m - m) * gcdRemainder m
  unfold gcdRemainder
  exact key.symm

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.gcdRemainder_dvd_X_add_one_pow_sub_mul_cofactor
statement:
lemma gcdRemainder_dvd_X_add_one_pow_sub_mul_cofactor
    (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    gcdRemainder m
      ∣ (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (m - p.parts.card) * hTernaryCofactor m p
proof:
:= by
  set σ := sigmaM m with _
  set c := p.parts.card with _
  have hFact : hTernary m p
      = (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (expSum m p) * hTernaryCofactor m p :=
    hTernary_eq_X_add_one_pow_mul_cofactor m p
  have hExp : expSum m p = σ - c := expSum_eq_sigmaM_sub_card m p hp
  have hc_le_m : c ≤ m := card_parts_le m p
  have hm_le_σ : m ≤ σ := m_le_sigmaM m
  have hExpDecomp : expSum m p = (σ - m) + (m - c) := by
    rw [hExp]
    omega
  have hGcdFact : gcdHTernary m
      = (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (σ - m) * gcdRemainder m :=
    gcdHTernary_eq_X_add_one_pow_mul_gcdRemainder m
  have hGcdDvd : gcdHTernary m ∣ hTernary m p := gcdHTernary_dvd_hTernary m p hp
  have hRewrite : hTernary m p
      = (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (σ - m)
        * ((Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (m - c) * hTernaryCofactor m p) := by
    rw [hFact, hExpDecomp, pow_add]
    ring
  have hDvdProd :
      (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (σ - m) * gcdRemainder m
        ∣ (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (σ - m)
          * ((Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (m - c) * hTernaryCofactor m p) := by
    rw [← hGcdFact, ← hRewrite]
    exact hGcdDvd
  have hNeZero : ((Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (σ - m) : Polynomial ℤ) ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ (X_add_C_ne_zero (1 : ℤ))
  exact (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hNeZero).mp hDvdProd

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.allOnesPart_mem_ternaryPartitions
statement:
lemma allOnesPart_mem_ternaryPartitions (m : ℕ) :
    allOnesPart m ∈ ternaryPartitions m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ternaryPartitions, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  intro i hi
  show IsPow3 i
  simp only [allOnesPart, Multiset.mem_replicate] at hi
  refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [hi.2]
  · simp [hi.2]

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.hTernaryCofactor_allOnes_eval_neg_one_ne_zero
statement:
lemma hTernaryCofactor_allOnes_eval_neg_one_ne_zero (m : ℕ) :
    (hTernaryCofactor m (allOnesPart m)).eval (-1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have allOnes_exp_zero : m / 3 ^ 0 - partMult (allOnesPart m) (3 ^ 0) = 0 := by
    simp [partMult_allOnes_one]
  have allOnes_exp_pos : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k →
      m / 3 ^ k - partMult (allOnesPart m) (3 ^ k) = m / 3 ^ k := by
    intro k hk
    rw [partMult_allOnes_three_pow_ge_one m k hk]
    simp
  have cofactorAdd_eval_neg_one : ∀ (N : ℕ),
      (cofactorAdd N).eval (-1) = (N : ℤ) := by
    intro N
    unfold cofactorAdd
    rw [eval_finset_sum]
    have h : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range N,
        Polynomial.eval (-1 : ℤ) ((-1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ i * Polynomial.X ^ i) = 1 := by
      intro i _
      simp [← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h]
    simp
  have range_succ_eq_insert_Ioc : Finset.range (m + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ioc 0 m) := by
    grind
  have hTernaryCofactor_allOnes_eq :
      hTernaryCofactor m (allOnesPart m) =
        ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 m, (cofactorAdd (3 ^ k)) ^ (m / 3 ^ k) := by
    unfold hTernaryCofactor
    rw [range_succ_eq_insert_Ioc]
    rw [Finset.prod_insert (by simp : (0 : ℕ) ∉ Finset.Ioc 0 m)]
    rw [allOnes_exp_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hk
    rw [allOnes_exp_pos k hk.1]
  rw [hTernaryCofactor_allOnes_eq]
  rw [Polynomial.eval_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro k hk
  rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hk
  obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hk
  rw [Polynomial.eval_pow, cofactorAdd_eval_neg_one]
  apply pow_ne_zero
  have h3k : (3 : ℕ) ^ k ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero k (by norm_num))
  exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp h3k

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.X_add_one_not_dvd_gcdRemainder
statement:
lemma X_add_one_not_dvd_gcdRemainder (m : ℕ) :
    ¬ ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ∣ gcdRemainder m)
proof:
:= by
  intro hdvd
  have hmem := allOnesPart_mem_ternaryPartitions m
  have hcard := allOnesPart_card m
  have hdvd2 := gcdRemainder_dvd_X_add_one_pow_sub_mul_cofactor m (allOnesPart m) hmem
  rw [hcard, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul] at hdvd2
  have hdvd3 : (Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ∣ hTernaryCofactor m (allOnesPart m) :=
    dvd_trans hdvd hdvd2
  have heval : (hTernaryCofactor m (allOnesPart m)).eval (-1) = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hdvd3
    rw [hq]
    simp [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_one]
  exact hTernaryCofactor_allOnes_eval_neg_one_ne_zero m heval

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.irreducible_X_add_one_int
statement:
lemma irreducible_X_add_one_int :
    Irreducible ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) = Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (-1 : ℤ) := by
    simp [sub_neg_eq_add]
  rw [h]
  exact Polynomial.irreducible_X_sub_C (-1 : ℤ)

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.isRelPrime_gcdRemainder_X_add_one_pow
statement:
lemma isRelPrime_gcdRemainder_X_add_one_pow (m n : ℕ) :
    IsRelPrime (gcdRemainder m) ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have hirr : Irreducible ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ)) :=
    irreducible_X_add_one_int
  have hnotdvd : ¬ ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ∣ gcdRemainder m) :=
    X_add_one_not_dvd_gcdRemainder m
  have h1 : IsRelPrime ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ)) (gcdRemainder m) :=
    (hirr.isRelPrime_iff_not_dvd).mpr hnotdvd
  have h2 : IsRelPrime (gcdRemainder m) ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ)) :=
    h1.symm
  exact h2.pow_right

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.gcdRemainder_dvd_hTernaryCofactor
statement:
lemma gcdRemainder_dvd_hTernaryCofactor
    (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    gcdRemainder m ∣ hTernaryCofactor m p
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : gcdRemainder m
      ∣ (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (m - p.parts.card) * hTernaryCofactor m p :=
    gcdRemainder_dvd_X_add_one_pow_sub_mul_cofactor m p hp
  have h2 : IsRelPrime (gcdRemainder m)
      ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (m - p.parts.card)) :=
    isRelPrime_gcdRemainder_X_add_one_pow m (m - p.parts.card)
  exact h2.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h1

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.gcdHTernary_dvd_X_add_one_pow_sub_mul_cofactor
statement:
lemma gcdHTernary_dvd_X_add_one_pow_sub_mul_cofactor
    (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    gcdHTernary m
      ∣ (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (sigmaM m - m) * hTernaryCofactor m p
proof:
:= by
  rw [gcdHTernary_eq_X_add_one_pow_mul_gcdRemainder]
  exact mul_dvd_mul_left _ (gcdRemainder_dvd_hTernaryCofactor m p hp)

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.gcdHTernary_mul_X_add_one_pow_dvd_hTernary
statement:
lemma gcdHTernary_mul_X_add_one_pow_dvd_hTernary
    (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m) (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    gcdHTernary m * ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (m - p.parts.card))
      ∣ hTernary m p
proof:
:= by
  have hcardle : p.parts.card ≤ m := card_parts_le m p
  have hmle : m ≤ sigmaM m := m_le_sigmaM m
  have hfact : hTernary m p
      = (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (expSum m p) * (hTernaryCofactor m p) :=
    hTernary_eq_X_add_one_pow_mul_cofactor m p
  have hexp : expSum m p = sigmaM m - p.parts.card :=
    expSum_eq_sigmaM_sub_card m p hp
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    gcdHTernary_dvd_X_add_one_pow_sub_mul_cofactor m p hp
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  rw [hfact, hexp]
  have key : (sigmaM m - p.parts.card) = (m - p.parts.card) + (sigmaM m - m) := by
    omega
  rw [key, pow_add]
  have hq' : (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (sigmaM m - m) * hTernaryCofactor m p
              = gcdHTernary m * q := hq
  calc (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (m - p.parts.card)
          * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (sigmaM m - m) * hTernaryCofactor m p
      = (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (m - p.parts.card)
          * ((Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (sigmaM m - m) * hTernaryCofactor m p) := by ring
    _ = (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (m - p.parts.card) * (gcdHTernary m * q) := by
          rw [hq']
    _ = gcdHTernary m * (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ (m - p.parts.card) * q := by ring

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.dvd_divByMonic_of_mul_dvd
statement:
lemma dvd_divByMonic_of_mul_dvd
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {f g h : Polynomial R}
    (hg : g.Monic) (hdvd : g * h ∣ f) :
    h ∣ f /ₘ g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  rw [hk, mul_assoc]
  exact Polynomial.mul_divByMonic_cancel_left (h * k) hg

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.X_add_one_pow_dvd_quotient
statement:
lemma X_add_one_pow_dvd_quotient (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m)
    (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) :
    ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (m - p.parts.card)) ∣
      (hTernary m p /ₘ gcdHTernary m)
proof:
:= by
  exact dvd_divByMonic_of_mul_dvd
    (gcdHTernary_monic m)
    (gcdHTernary_mul_X_add_one_pow_dvd_hTernary m p hp)

name: Conj9.Aux_X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes.X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes
statement:
lemma X_add_one_dvd_quotient_of_ne_allOnes (m : ℕ) (p : Nat.Partition m)
    (hp : p ∈ ternaryPartitions m) (hne : p ≠ allOnesPart m) :
    (Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ∣ (hTernary m p /ₘ gcdHTernary m)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : p.parts.card < m := card_parts_lt_of_ne_allOnes m p hp hne
  have hpow : ((Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (m - p.parts.card)) ∣
      (hTernary m p /ₘ gcdHTernary m) := X_add_one_pow_dvd_quotient m p hp
  have hge : 1 ≤ m - p.parts.card := by omega
  
  have hdvd1 : (Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ∣
      (Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (m - p.parts.card) :=
    dvd_pow_self _ (by omega)
  exact hdvd1.trans hpow

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.allOnesPart_isTernary
statement: lemma allOnesPart_isTernary (m : ℕ) : IsTernary (allOnesPart m)
proof:
:= by

  simp only [allOnesPart, Multiset.mem_replicate] at hi

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.allOnesPart_mem_ternaryPartitions
statement:
lemma allOnesPart_mem_ternaryPartitions (m : ℕ) :

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.hTernary_allOnes_monic
statement:
lemma hTernary_allOnes_monic (m : ℕ) :
    (hTernary m (allOnesPart m)).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold hTernary
  refine Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun k _ => ?_)
  refine Polynomial.Monic.pow ?_ _
  have hne : (3 : ℕ) ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  have heq : (1 : Polynomial ℤ) + Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k)
      = Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) + Polynomial.C 1 := by
    simp [add_comm]
  rw [heq]
  exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add_C 1 hne

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.gcdHTernary_monic
statement: lemma gcdHTernary_monic (m : ℕ) : (gcdHTernary m).Monic
proof:
:= by
  apply monic_of_normalize_eq_self_of_dvd_monic
    (p := hTernary m (allOnesPart m))
  · exact normalize_finset_gcd_polynomial_int _ _
  · exact Finset.gcd_dvd (allOnesPart_mem_ternaryPartitions m)
  · exact hTernary_allOnes_monic m

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.X_pow_two_three_pow_sub_one_eq_mul_a
statement:
lemma X_pow_two_three_pow_sub_one_eq_mul_a (k : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (2 * 3 ^ k) - 1
      = (Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) - 1) * (Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : ℕ) * 3 ^ k = 3 ^ k + 3 ^ k := by ring
  rw [h2, pow_add]
  ring

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.three_pow_dvd_two_mul_a
statement: lemma three_pow_dvd_two_mul_a (k : ℕ) : 3 ^ k ∣ 2 * 3 ^ k
proof:
:=
  ⟨2, by ring⟩

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.two_mul_three_pow_ne_zero_a
statement: lemma two_mul_three_pow_ne_zero_a (k : ℕ) : (2 * 3 ^ k : ℕ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : (3 : ℕ) ^ k ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.two_mul_three_pow_injective_a
statement: lemma two_mul_three_pow_injective_a : Function.Injective (fun j : ℕ => 2 * 3 ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  simp only at hab
  have : (3 : ℕ) ^ a = 3 ^ b := by omega

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.X_pow_three_pow_sub_one_ne_zero_a
statement:
lemma X_pow_three_pow_sub_one_ne_zero_a (k : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k) - 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hdeg : ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k) - 1).natDegree = 3 ^ k := by
    have hrw : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k) - 1
              = Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) + Polynomial.C (-1) := by
      rw [Polynomial.C_neg, Polynomial.C_1]; ring
    rw [hrw]
    exact Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_add_C
  rw [h, Polynomial.natDegree_zero] at hdeg
  have : (3 : ℕ) ^ k ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
  omega

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.two_mul_three_pow_dvd_two_mul_three_pow_a
statement:
lemma two_mul_three_pow_dvd_two_mul_three_pow_a
    (j k : ℕ) (h : j ≤ k) : 2 * 3 ^ j ∣ 2 * 3 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left 2 (pow_dvd_pow 3 h)

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.exists_eq_two_mul_three_pow_of_dvd_not_dvd_a
statement:
lemma exists_eq_two_mul_three_pow_of_dvd_not_dvd_a
    (k d : ℕ) (h1 : d ∣ 2 * 3 ^ k) (h2 : ¬ d ∣ 3 ^ k) :
    ∃ j ≤ k, d = 2 * 3 ^ j
proof:
:= by
  have h2dvd : 2 ∣ d := by
    by_contra h2nd
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime 2 d :=
      (Nat.prime_two.coprime_iff_not_dvd).mpr h2nd
    exact h2 (hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h1)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h2dvd
  have hxdvd : x ∣ 3 ^ k := by
    have : 2 * x ∣ 2 * 3 ^ k := hx ▸ h1
    exact (Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (by norm_num : (0:ℕ) < 2)).mp this
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow Nat.prime_three).mp hxdvd
  exact ⟨j, hj, by rw [hx, hxj]⟩

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.two_mul_three_pow_not_dvd_three_pow_a
statement: lemma two_mul_three_pow_not_dvd_three_pow_a (j k : ℕ) : ¬ (2 * 3 ^ j ∣ 3 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h₁ : 2 ∣ 3 ^ k := by
    have h₂ : 2 ∣ 2 * 3 ^ j := by
      apply dvd_mul_right
    exact dvd_trans h₂ h
  have h₂ : ¬(2 ∣ 3 ^ k) := by
    have h₃ : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ^ n % 2 = 1 := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        simp [Nat.mul_mod, ih]
    have h₄ : 3 ^ k % 2 = 1 := h₃ k
    omega
  exact h₂ h₁

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.divisors_two_mul_three_pow_sdiff_divisors_three_pow_a
statement:
lemma divisors_two_mul_three_pow_sdiff_divisors_three_pow_a (k : ℕ) :
    (2 * 3 ^ k).divisors \ (3 ^ k).divisors
      = (Finset.range (k + 1)).image (fun j => 2 * 3 ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Nat.mem_divisors, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hd1, _⟩, hd2⟩
    have h3k : (3 : ℕ) ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
    have hnd : ¬ d ∣ 3 ^ k := by
      intro hdvd
      exact hd2 ⟨hdvd, h3k⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hjk, hdj⟩ := exists_eq_two_mul_three_pow_of_dvd_not_dvd_a k d hd1 hnd
    exact ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hjk, hdj.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, hdj⟩
    have hjk : j ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hj
    subst hdj
    refine ⟨⟨two_mul_three_pow_dvd_two_mul_three_pow_a j k hjk, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have : (2 : ℕ) * 3 ^ k ≠ 0 := by positivity
      exact this
    · intro ⟨hdvd, _⟩
      exact two_mul_three_pow_not_dvd_three_pow_a j k hdvd

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.one_add_X_pow_three_pow_eq_prod_cyclotomic_a
statement:
lemma one_add_X_pow_three_pow_eq_prod_cyclotomic_a (k : ℕ) :
    (1 : Polynomial ℤ) + Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k)
      = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * 3 ^ j) ℤ
proof:
:= by
  have h_cyc :
      (Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) - 1 : Polynomial ℤ)
        * ∏ x ∈ (2 * 3 ^ k).divisors \ (3 ^ k).divisors,
            Polynomial.cyclotomic x ℤ
      = Polynomial.X ^ (2 * 3 ^ k) - 1 :=
    Polynomial.X_pow_sub_one_mul_prod_cyclotomic_eq_X_pow_sub_one_of_dvd ℤ
      (three_pow_dvd_two_mul_a k) (two_mul_three_pow_ne_zero_a k)
  have h_diff := X_pow_two_three_pow_sub_one_eq_mul_a k
  rw [h_diff] at h_cyc
  have h_ne : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) ^ (3 ^ k) - 1 ≠ 0 :=
    X_pow_three_pow_sub_one_ne_zero_a k
  have h_eq : (Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k) + 1 : Polynomial ℤ)
        = ∏ x ∈ (2 * 3 ^ k).divisors \ (3 ^ k).divisors, Polynomial.cyclotomic x ℤ := by
    exact (mul_left_cancel₀ h_ne h_cyc).symm
  have h_set := divisors_two_mul_three_pow_sdiff_divisors_three_pow_a k
  rw [h_set] at h_eq
  rw [Finset.prod_image (fun a _ b _ h => two_mul_three_pow_injective_a h)] at h_eq
  rw [add_comm 1 _]
  exact h_eq

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.hTernary_allOnes_eq_prod_Ioc_a
statement:
lemma hTernary_allOnes_eq_prod_Ioc_a (m : ℕ) :
    hTernary m (allOnesPart m)
      = ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 m,
          (1 + Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ k)) ^ (m / 3 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hTernary
  have hsplit : Finset.range (m + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ioc 0 m) := by
    ext k
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ioc, Finset.mem_insert]
    omega
  rw [hsplit]
  rw [Finset.prod_insert (by simp)]
  have hzero :
      (1 + Polynomial.X ^ (3 ^ 0)) ^
          (m / 3 ^ 0 - partMult (allOnesPart m) (3 ^ 0))
        = (1 : Polynomial ℤ) := by
    have : partMult (allOnesPart m) (3 ^ 0) = m := by
      simp [partMult_allOnes_one]
    rw [this]
    simp
  rw [hzero, one_mul]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hk
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := hk.1
  rw [partMult_allOnes_three_pow_ge_one m k hk1]
  rw [Nat.sub_zero]

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.hTernary_allOnes_eq_double_prod_a
statement:
lemma hTernary_allOnes_eq_double_prod_a (m : ℕ) :
    hTernary m (allOnesPart m)
      = ∏ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 m,
          ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
            (Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * 3 ^ j) ℤ) ^ (m / 3 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hTernary_allOnes_eq_prod_Ioc_a]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
  intro k _
  rw [one_add_X_pow_three_pow_eq_prod_cyclotomic_a, Finset.prod_pow]

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.inner_prod_j_zero_a
statement:
lemma inner_prod_j_zero_a (m : ℕ) :
    (∏ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 m,
        (Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * 3 ^ (0 : ℕ)) ℤ) ^ (m / 3 ^ k))
      = (Polynomial.cyclotomic 2 ℤ) ^ (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 m, m / 3 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (2 * 3 ^ (0 : ℕ) : ℕ) = 2 := by norm_num
  rw [h]
  exact Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum _ _ _

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.inner_prod_eq_pow_sum_a
statement:
lemma inner_prod_eq_pow_sum_a (m j : ℕ) :
    (∏ k ∈ Finset.Ico j (m + 1),
        (Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * 3 ^ j) ℤ) ^ (m / 3 ^ k))
      = (Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * 3 ^ j) ℤ)
          ^ (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico j (m + 1), m / 3 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum (Finset.Ico j (m + 1)) (fun k => m / 3 ^ k)
    (Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * 3 ^ j) ℤ)

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.swap_double_prod_aux_a
statement:
lemma swap_double_prod_aux_a (m : ℕ) :
    (∏ k ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 m,
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          (Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * 3 ^ j) ℤ) ^ (m / 3 ^ k))
      = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
          ∏ k ∈ (Finset.Ioc 0 m).filter (fun k => j ≤ k),
            (Polynomial.cyclotomic (2 * 3 ^ j) ℤ) ^ (m / 3 ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_comm'
  intro k j
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ioc, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_filter]
  omega

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.filter_Ioc_eq_Ico_a
statement:
lemma filter_Ioc_eq_Ico_a (m j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    (Finset.Ioc 0 m).filter (fun k => j ≤ k) = Finset.Ico j (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ioc, Finset.mem_Ico]
  omega

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.filter_Ioc_zero_eq_a
statement:
lemma filter_Ioc_zero_eq_a (m : ℕ) :
    (Finset.Ioc 0 m).filter (fun k => (0 : ℕ) ≤ k) = Finset.Ioc 0 m
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.filter_true_of_mem
  intro k hk
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hk ⊢
  omega

name: Conj9.Aux_quotient_allOnes_eval_neg_one_eq_pow_val3.range_succ_eq_insert_Ioc_a
statement:
lemma range_succ_eq_insert_Ioc_a (m : ℕ) :
    Finset.range (m + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ioc 0 m)
proof:
:= by

  simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ioc, Finset.mem_insert]
